description: Claude is an AI assistant by Anthropic that can support writing, analysis, coding, document work and reasoning-oriented tasks.
usage: Describe the outcome you need, provide relevant context and share source material when appropriate. Ask Claude to structure the response and identify assumptions or uncertainties.

examples.title: Document review
examples.content: Review the following project brief. Summarize its goals, list unclear requirements and create a risk checklist: [paste brief].

examples.title: Code explanation
examples.content: Explain this JavaScript function step by step. Identify edge cases and suggest a cleaner implementation without changing behavior: [paste code].

examples.title: Writing refinement
examples.content: Rewrite this paragraph to be clear and professional. Preserve all factual details and list any ambiguous statements separately.

questions.question: What is Claude?
questions.answer: Claude is an AI assistant developed by Anthropic for tasks such as writing, analysis, coding and working with information.

questions.question: Who develops Claude?
questions.answer: Claude is developed by Anthropic, an AI safety and research company.

questions.question: What tasks can Claude support?
questions.answer: It can help draft and edit text, explain concepts, analyze supported documents, brainstorm and assist with programming.

questions.question: How do I get a useful answer from Claude?
questions.answer: Give a clear task, relevant context, constraints and an example of the desired output when useful.

questions.question: What is a long-context task?
questions.answer: It is a task that requires the model to consider a comparatively large amount of supplied information.

questions.question: Can Claude review code?
questions.answer: Yes. It can explain code, identify potential issues and suggest improvements. Run tests before accepting changes.

questions.question: Can Claude help with technical documentation?
questions.answer: Yes. It can help organize requirements, explain APIs and draft documentation from supplied source material.

questions.question: What is an assumption?
questions.answer: An assumption is something treated as true for the task even though it has not been confirmed.

questions.question: Why ask an AI to list assumptions?
questions.answer: It helps reveal missing information and makes it easier to validate the reasoning.

questions.question: Can Claude rewrite content?
questions.answer: Yes. Specify the audience, tone, length and facts that must remain unchanged.

questions.question: What is a structured response?
questions.answer: A response organized into predictable sections such as summary, steps, risks and recommendations.

questions.question: How can I ask Claude to compare options?
questions.answer: Provide the options and criteria, then request a comparison table and a reasoned conclusion.

questions.question: Should I share private documents?
questions.answer: Only when permitted by your privacy and organizational policies. Remove sensitive details when possible.

questions.question: Can Claude make factual errors?
questions.answer: Yes. Verify important claims against authoritative sources and the original documents.

questions.question: What is a good document-analysis prompt?
questions.answer: Ask for a summary, key points, open questions, risks and references to the relevant sections.

questions.question: How do I prevent a rewrite from changing meaning?
questions.answer: Tell Claude to preserve facts, names, figures and intent, and ask it to flag unclear source text instead of guessing.

questions.question: Can Claude help plan a software project?
questions.answer: Yes. It can help break work into milestones, identify dependencies and draft acceptance criteria.

questions.question: What is an acceptance criterion?
questions.answer: It is a testable condition that must be satisfied for a requirement or feature to be considered complete.

questions.question: Why should generated code be tested?
questions.answer: Because code may contain defects, security issues or assumptions that do not match your application.

questions.question: How do I improve an incomplete answer?
questions.answer: Point out the missing requirement, add context and request a revised response that addresses it explicitly.
